title: Verdant+
description: VerdantPlus is a modpack that enhances your vanilla experience.
body: This modpack, known as either Verdant+ or VerdantPlus, is a slimmed-down utility and performance toolkit created for Minecraft 1.21.11 with the Fabric loader. It aims to improve the basic gameplay experience by making extensive technical optimizations and quality-of-life changes without changing the underlying "Vanilla" experience of the game.
